svg.title: bev_fusion: camera + radar BEV system in five layers
svg.text: bev_fusion: camera + radar BEV system in five layers

Built 2026-11-01 (Mirko's layered design). Left of the input interface nothing learns; between the two interfaces every slot is a swappable block chosen in ModelConfig (one builder table per slot, tests/test_slots.py) with no rule step; right of the output interface only the selection of boxes and line cells for the metrics, and later the planner.
main path (bold): 14 stages = 8 learned, 2 fixed-differentiable, 4 frozen, 0 rule steps
3 network: one slot per block, the kind chosen in ModelConfig, a contract test per kind
legend (bold arrow = main path or the information flow; dashed arrow = optional or no data flow through it)
precompute: deterministic, cached with an identity, no weights learned before it
interface: one typed contract (names, shapes, units, frames)
